name: What should I prepare before an on-site walkthrough of a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an on-site walkthrough of a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an initial contractor walkthrough, gather any property inspection reports, seller disclosure notices, and a clear list of non-negotiable fixes versus desired upgrades. Determine whether municipal utilities like water, gas, and electricity are safely turned on, as contractors need utility access to inspect fixtures and evaluate damage accurately. It also helps to clarify your ultimate objective: whether you are renovating the home as a long-term personal residence, an accessible rental property, or a fast turnaround project. Having defined goals and utility access allows the contractor to accurately assess framing, subfloors, and interior surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather inspection reports, confirm utility status, and outline your core project goals so the contractor can thoroughly examine interior framing, drywall, and finishes.
